newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Anderton says NZ dlr one-way bet for investors.
newsitem.headline: Anderton says NZ dlr one-way bet for investors.

text.p: Alliance leader Jim Anderton said on Monday that the Kiwi dollar presented offshore investors with a one-way bet and New Zealanders were paying the price of their profits.

"The Reserve Bank drives interest rates up to suppress inflation. Overseas money is flooding into the country because we now have the highest real interest rates in the Western world," Anderton said in a statement.
"That inflow of money is pushing the dollar higher and higher and fuelling domestic credit growth, which in turn creates more inflationary pressure."
The New Zealand dollar's Trade-Weighted Index is at its highest levels since late 1987.

Anderton said manufacturers, farmers and employers who were being "driven to the wall" by the strong dollar should blame their own sector group leaders for supporting the conservative National Party government in last year's election.
"The government is repaying the support of those sector groups with viciously anti-business policies," he said.
